content:
Thanks for proving the steps however I haven't been able to replicate the issue.

I wonder if the message compose screen is crashing and returning to the message list. It seems like a failure is occuring before the email is moved to outbox.

There's been a number of different circumstances identified which trigger the compose screen to crash. I wonder if your experiencing another. See below for more info. Developers have a fix applied for these reports and will be included in an upcoming release.

Are you rotating the screen at any point before sending the message? Does the recipient have a long email address?

https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/11302

In your case, there may be something specific about the attachment that triggers a crash. I've asked a few times, can you confirm what file type and size the attachment is, for example a large photo.

Are you able to capture a debug log?

  • Enable this from settings > general settings > debugging: enable debug log.
  • Replicate the issue by trying to send an email with attachment.
  • Save the debug log from the three dot menu on the debug page.

Guide: https://thunderbird.github.io/thunderbird-android/docs/latest/user-guide/troubleshooting/collecting-debug-logs.html

Does the log have an entry saying "beginning of crash".
